promptAsSent:
Use the image_gen tool to generate exactly one image, then stop. Do not write files, run commands or edit anything.

Use case: title logo for the end of a game cinematic. Direction: worn stamped metal nameplate. Starsector Marines is a grounded game about a small mercenary marine company of refugees from a failing mining station who arrive on a jungle world in a patched old ship. The mark is a wide, low riveted steel nameplate of the kind bolted to old industrial machinery: a horizontal plate with chamfered corners and four rivets, the letters MARINES raised and embossed from the plate in heavy squared industrial capitals, their raised faces rubbed bright where paint has worn off, the recessed field painted a dark gunmetal grey that is chipped and scratched. STARSECTOR is smaller, stamped into a narrow band along the top edge of the plate. Warm daylight from the upper left, subtle realistic metal, gentle wear and a touch of rust at the rivets; not chrome, not shiny, not a video-game bevel. The plate itself is the logo shape; everything outside the plate is transparent.

Lettering must be spelled exactly, in capital letters: the setting name STARSECTOR, small, and the mod's name MARINES, large and dominant; MARINES is the identity of the mark and STARSECTOR is a modest subtitle. No other words, numbers or letters anywhere. This is an original logo for a fan-made game mod: do not imitate the logo, typeface or emblem of any existing game, studio or franchise, and do not add trademark symbols. True transparent background, including the spaces inside and between letters; no ground, no backdrop, no drop shadow slab, no border, no frame, no mockup, no watermark. Wide landscape canvas. The whole mark centred with generous empty margin around it. Flat-on front view, not in perspective, not on an object. It will be composited over a bright aerial photograph of grey concrete and green jungle, so it needs strong value contrast at its edges and must stay legible at a quarter of screen width.
agentMessages: I’ll generate one image with the worn steel nameplate design and transparent background.
